newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia RTS share index closes at record 313.50.
newsitem.headline: Russia RTS share index closes at record 313.50.

text.p: The Russian Trading System 24-share index rose 0.9 percent on Friday to close at a record 313.50, NAUFOR brokers association figures showed.
Traders said less liquid shares, including preferred second-tier stock, showed the highest gains and leading shares rose on purchses of paper covered by American Depositary Receipts.
Volume on the Russian Trading System was $32.81 million.
"The situation in less liquid shares was nuts -- everyone was buying, no one was selling," said IFCI-Moscow Partners chief trader Alexei Abdurakhmanov.
"Everthing quoted on RTS-2 (less liquid shares) has surged and many papers posted 20 to 50 percent growth. People just lifted offers."
Traders said there was demand for preferred shares of second-tier companies on expectation of further growth.
Traders forecast steady growth but said that the strong demand for less liquid shares would calm down on Monday.
"This (sharp growth) cannot last long. But prices will not fall much -- we will simply establish new levels," Abdurakhimov said.

Utility Kolenergo prefs rose to $0.20/$0.40 from $0.16/$0.19 at Thursday's close, telecom Elektrosvyaz (Irkutsk region) rose to $0.70/$0.80 from $0.63/$0.79 and telecom Lensvyaz rose to $24.5/$31.0 from $20.0/$22.50.
UCB chief trader Samit Yakovlev said prefs of regional oil companies were likely to appreciate as the discount to ordinary shares closed.
Traders said Surgutneftegaz SNGS.RTS had risen on a single purchase of the oil company's ADRs.
Surgutneftegaz preferreds rose to $0.481 from $0.455 and ordinary shares firmed to $0.685 from $0.631.
